questions.questionText: Describe the Brachial Plexus in detail including roots, trunks, cords, branches, and clinical correlations.
questions.referenceAnswer: Roots C5-T1, Upper/Middle/Lower trunks, Anterior/Posterior divisions, Lateral/Medial/Posterior cords. Axillary relations. Erb and Klumpke palsies.

questions.questionText: Describe the blood supply of the thyroid gland.
questions.referenceAnswer: Superior thyroid artery (ECA branch), Inferior thyroid artery (thyrocervical trunk), Thyroid ima artery (occasional). Venous drainage to IJV and brachiocephalic vein.
